environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in production VPC. Container uses DATABASE_URL with credentials for 'appuser' PostgreSQL role. The 'appuser' role has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'public' schema. RDS PostgreSQL 15.4 instance with no row-level security policies. ALB forwards traffic directly to container on port 8080 with no WAF attached.

config.db_user_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO appuser
config.rds_config: PostgreSQL 15.4, no RLS policies, no column-level privileges
